title: Follow-Up Sequences
prompt:
Act as a B2B sales sequence strategist.
Deal context        :  [WHAT YOU PROPOSED AND WHAT THEY SAID]
Prospect role      :  [JOB TITLE AND INDUSTRY]
Last contact        :  [WHAT HAPPENED IN YOUR LAST INTERACTION]
Build a 7-touch follow-up sequence:
Touch 1 (Day 1)    :  Post-meeting summary and one insight
Touch 2 (Day 3)   :  Relevant content or case study
Touch 3 (Day 6)   :  Answer a question they didn't ask yet
Touch 4 (Day 10) :  Social proof specific to their industry
Touch 5 (Day 15) :  New angle  challenge their status quo
Touch 6 (Day 22) :  Offer to simplify or reduce scope
Touch 7 (Day 30) :  Break-up email  honest and respectful
For each touch    :  write the subject line and opening sentence.
Keep every message under 60 words.
Follow-Up Cadence : 80% of Sales Need 5+ Touches

PRO TIP
The break-up email (Touch 7) consistently generates the highest reply rate of any touch
in a sequence. Something about 'I'm going to stop reaching out' creates a response that
seven other emails didn't. Write it genuinely  not as a manipulation tactic. If you really
are moving on, say so honestly.
